The original mechanic sits farther inside at the LEFT side of the dinette, body turned toward the RIGHT, gesturing to the under-bench storage and a simple unlettered camper plan lying on the table. assets.specific: Image 1 is the edit target and identity/style reference. Change to a CLOSE-UP over the customer's shoulder focusing on the mechanic's reassuring expression as he explains the work before starting. Mechanic's face and upper chest occupy the LEFT and CENTER, much larger than in the original; he turns three-quarter toward the RIGHT and looks attentively at the customer, mouth slightly open in a natural mid-explanation smile. Clean-shaven adult with same wavy black hair, expressive restrained adult eyes, not childlike. On the far RIGHT foreground show only a cropped soft-edged rear silhouette of the original female owner's brown tied hair and olive shoulder, no second visible face. At the LOWER edge one clear hand of the mechanic points at a simple blank/unlettered clipboard seen obliquely between them; do not show the mechanic below chest. A small muted hint of an olive workshop tool board behind is enough, no whole camper and no full reception counter. Use a stronger intimate shoulder-level viewpoint and asymmetry. Maintain clean manga line work, calm warm light, true transparency around the silhouette and small backdrop fragment.
